Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC is hiring a Product Software Engineer I for the Cannonball squad. The role develops and maintains an enterprise CMS and publishing platform used to create and distribute marketing landing pages and related experiences across Disney streaming services. The engineer builds web app features and APIs, writes automated tests, and collaborates with QA and partner squads.
Media and Entertainment
Broadcasting
Film Production
Responsibilities
Feature Development: Build features on the Cannonball web app and supporting services—including entry editor, content models, publishing workflows, localization/locale behavior, and integrations with the broader MarTech ecosystem
UI & API Engineering: Implement bug fixes and incremental improvements in Vue 3 / TypeScript UI and Node-based APIs, with a strong focus on clarity and maintainability
Automated Testing: Write unit tests (Vitest), integration tests, and Playwright E2E suites for Tier 1 publish journeys following squad Definition of Done and coverage expectations
Agile Participation: Participate actively in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and tech discussions; ask questions early and document learnings
Operational Awareness: Leverage stage/pre-prod environments and our isolated E2E environment to validate changes prior to production
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with QA governance, sibling squads (Web Growth / Nexus), and internal daily power users

Required
Solid understanding of JavaScript or TypeScript and core web fundamentals (HTML/CSS, HTTP, REST, browser devtools)
Coursework, internships, or personal projects demonstrating your ability to implement, test, and debug small features end-to-end
Comfort learning within a large codebase and proactively seeking guidance
Clear written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field of study, or equivalent work experience
Preferred
Exposure to Vue, React, or another modern SPA framework
Familiarity with Git version control, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions or similar)
Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, or E2E)
Interest in CMS platforms, content modeling, localization, or marketing technology
